scope: Descriptive histograms requested by user, frozen first-error sensitivity trials; no new inference or model selection.
weight: equal trace, paired error and maximum on identical populations
relative_coordinate: zero-based original position / max(original_L - 1, 1); one-step traces at 0
uniform_reference: Uniform among original candidates; first position excluded only in the specified case; exact expectation not Monte Carlo.
posterior_steps: Included as generated states; labels are absorbing unreached, no independent correctness assertion.
